description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ComputedItemListTrait' that provides common functionality for computed item lists within Drupal's TypedData API, including methods for value computation, access, and manipulation.

methods.name: computeValue
methods.description: Abstract method to compute the values for an item list, to be implemented by classes using this trait.

methods.name: ensureComputedValue
methods.description: Ensures that the values are computed only once; calls computeValue if not already computed.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value after ensuring it has been computed.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value and marks the list as computed.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Returns the string representation after ensuring values are computed.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an item at a specific index, ensuring values are computed first.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets an item at a specific index after ensuring values are computed.

methods.name: appendItem
methods.description: Appends an item to the list after ensuring values are computed.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item at a specific index after ensuring values are computed.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the list is empty after ensuring values are computed.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if an offset exists after ensuring values are computed.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the list after ensuring values are computed.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the count of items after ensuring values are computed.

methods.name: applyDefaultValue
methods.description: Method for applying default values, overridden to do nothing for computed lists.
